name: RecurrenceEditor
tagline: The Recurrence Editor lets people set up a repeat schedule on a record, the same way they set up a recurring meeting in Outlook.
description: The Recurrence Editor lets people set up a repeat schedule on a record, the same way they set up a recurring meeting in Outlook. They choose how often something happens, on which days, from when and until when, and the control immediately shows a plain-English summary and the next dates that will happen.
features: Monthly or yearly patterns with presets, end rules, skipped dates, holiday handling
A live next-dates preview (list or calendar) and an iCalendar RRULE value plus summary / next occurrence / count outputs
